observations.note: The retry knew by turn 19 that only three reading-list items needed a locator, yet it re-read specs, code and tests for about 140 more turns before its first edit at turn 164.
The session reached 228k tokens before its first write and peaked at 311k, with 92 turns above 200k, because a retry started from a full re-verification instead of a narrow fix list.
Sixteen files were opened more than once, including spec files whose ids earlier greps had already shown.
Two greps used look-around, which the search tool rejects without PCRE2, and the same lint pattern was re-run three times.
